about: The Darts & Pool polos' Zip-up collar choice (zoneColors.poloZip, set by Garment style > Collar; the Button-up choice and every other polo keep polo-shirt.glb): Tripo model polo-shirt-textured.glb (its shape only: its painted colours and its own UV atlas are not used; coloured from polo-shirt-parts.glb by viewer/tripo-glbparts.mjs, MODELQ5 2026-11-19), cards 27480 (front) / 27486 (back): a stand-up collar with a short zip at the neck, which is carried on straight down the centre front to the hem as our own zip tape and metal teeth (the user's mockup 612; data `zip`, main.js).
